data.gender_notes: Phyllida is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word phyllon, meaning 'leaf'. In Greek mythology, Phyllida was a nymph who took the form of a tree or a leaf. In Christianity, Phyllida represents a connection to nature and the divine. The name Phyllida carries the meaning “Lover of nature” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Phyllida usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of nature and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the interconnectedness of all things in nature and the divine.
data.etymology: Phyllida belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of nature.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Phyllida total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

In the Bible, there is no direct reference to the name Phyllida. However, it is a popular name in Christian cultures, symbolizing the abundance of God's love and grace. In Christian tradition, the name Phyllida is associated with the virtues of joy, happiness, and celebration. People with this name are often seen as optimistic, enthusiastic, and joyful individuals who bring happiness to those around them.
